question: The function $f(x)=[x]+\sqrt{x-[x]}$, where $[x]$ denotes the largest integer smaller than or equal to $x$, is

options.B: continuous at every real number $x$ except at negative integer values
options.C: continuous at every real number $x$ except at integer values
options.D: continuous at every real number $x$ except at $x=0
